anomalies.description: Multiple armed individuals are engaged in close-quarters combat behind a wrecked vehicle and wall; they are crouched, aiming, and moving aggressively in a coordinated assault posture.

A soldier in silhouette fires a rifle, with visible muzzle flash and smoke erupting from the barrel at frame f6 (11.0s) and persisting through f7 (11.5s).; Close-up of a soldier shouting while aiming and firing a rifle; muzzle flash is visible at f8 (12.0s), and the weapon is actively engaged through f10 (13.0s).; Group of soldiers in tactical formation actively firing rifles from behind cover (a wrecked vehicle and wall); multiple muzzle flashes and weapon recoil visible across frames f12–f14.
A soldier in tactical gear is actively firing a rifle; muzzle flash and smoke are visible at the barrel, indicating live gunfire.

A violent group confrontation is depicted: multiple armed soldiers in combat formation engage in a firefight in a graffiti-covered urban alley, consistent with collective violent unrest or armed clash between groups.

A group of soldiers in tactical gear are actively aiming and firing rifles from behind cover (a damaged vehicle) in an urban environment; muzzle flash or recoil is not clearly visible, but the posture, weapon alignment, and synchronized readiness strongly indicate active engagement/shooting.
Soldiers in tactical gear are actively firing weapons from behind cover; muzzle flashes and weapon recoil visible in frames f0–f2.
A soldier fires a rifle with visible muzzle flash and dust/debris displacement; sustained fire observed across frames f5–f7.

A soldier is physically restrained and appears to be injured or incapacitated while another soldier administers aid or subdues him; hands on chest, helmet removed, and struggle evident in close-up frames f8–f15.

A soldier in full gear is seen physically restraining and subduing another soldier who appears incapacitated or helpless, using hands on the head and chest while the victim is pinned against a wall; no mutual resistance is visible.

A soldier in the foreground is holding a rifle in a ready-to-fire posture; muzzle flash or bullet tracers are not visible, but the context of advancing under fire and the presence of other soldiers taking cover strongly suggest active engagement. In frame f0 (42.5s), the soldier’s stance and weapon orientation indicate imminent or ongoing shooting.

Frames f2–f4 show a wide view of multiple armed individuals moving through a debris-strewn urban area with tents and barricades, suggesting organized violent unrest rather than a formal military operation. However, visual evidence of collective violent clashes (e.g., opposing groups fighting) is indirect; the scene could also be a combat zone. Given the ambiguity, confidence is moderate.

In frames f5–f6 (45.0–45.5s), soldiers are seen moving along a dirt path with weapons raised; by f9 (47.0s), one soldier is actively aiming and appears to be firing from behind cover. The sequence shows coordinated advance under fire, with at least one individual engaging a target.

Frames f11–f14 show soldiers in silhouette against bright backlight, with one soldier standing atop rubble raising a weapon in a clear firing motion (f12–f14). The posture, weapon elevation, and context of sustained movement under fire confirm active shooting. No muzzle flash visible, but the action is unambiguous.
